template: A_{s,c,e}(t) = sum_k v_{s,k} * s_{k,c,e} * h_k(t) * carea_k ; s_{k,c,e} = frac_{k,c,e} / L_k ; L_k = sum_{c,e} frac_{k,c,e}
variables: A km2 habitat area of species s in country c x biome e; v species land share of cell k; s land share of c x e in the cell (Natural Earth cover / total country cover of the cell); h LUH2 habitat fraction of the whole cell (primary = primf+primn; natural = + secdf+secdn); carea cell area km2; L Natural Earth land cover of the cell
note: 05 §9 area basis (2026-10-22): LUH2 states already exclude water, so no land_frac factor on habitat; species cover and country cover independent within a cell

template: v_{s,k} = presence_{s,k}
variables: presence 1 if Borgelt cloglog suitability >= cutoff.spec.sens (0.5 deg cell split into four 0.25 deg children)

template: v_{s,k} = min(1, suitability_{s,k} / L_k)
variables: suitability = fraction of the whole 0.25 deg cell covered by the species' dissolved IUCN polygons; L_k Natural Earth land cover of the cell
note: IUCN 2022-1 polygons (range_source iucn_spatial); presence (for counts only) = land_frac > 0 and (cover >= 0.5 or the species' max-cover land cell)

template: A^PA_{s,c,e}(t) = sum_k v_{s,k} * s_{k,c,e} * h_k(t) * carea_k * p_k ; p_k = pa_frac_k / land_frac_k
variables: p protected share of the cell's land (class all / PA / OECM; roster present or dated STATUS_YR <= year); habitat and protection assumed independent within a cell

template: rho_{s,c,e} = A^range_{s,c,e} / sum_{c',e'} A^range_{s,c',e'} ; A^range = sum_k v * s * land_frac_k * carea_k
variables: habitat-independent range area; denominator over the whole world incl. XXX

template: L_{c,e} = sum_k s_{k,c,e} * land_frac_k * carea_k
variables: country x biome land on the share basis; biome 0 pools every land cell of the country

template: share_pa_{c,e} = sum_k s_{k,c,e} * pa_frac_k * carea_k / L_{c,e}
variables: pa_frac dissolved PA(+OECM) land fraction of the cell (N03: min(cover, land_frac)); pa_year present or dated
note: comparable to GBF indicator 3.1 terrestrial coverage

template: h_primary = primf + primn ; h_natural = primf + primn + secdf + secdn
variables: LUH2 v2h state fractions
note: primary = default (never regrows); natural = optimistic bound (03 D1)

template: L_{s,c,e,m}(t; t0, def) = 1 - (A_{s,c,e}(t; def) / A_{s,c,e}(t0; def))^{z_{s,m}}
variables: R = A_t/A_0; z species exponent for metric m (AC or GD) in the marker domain; lens area, value_kind loss
note: 03 §2a; negative L possible for natural (stored, display clipped)

template: R_full_s(t; t0, def) = A_s(t; all cells) / A_s(t0; all cells)
variables: sensitivity column: the species' whole-range ratio (Q3 alternative), not used in the default
P = A_PA/A_t; pa_class all/PA/OECM; pa_year present (2015 habitat) or dated 1950..2015 (that year's habitat); lens protection, value_kind secured

template: L_{s,m} = 1 - (1 - a_iucn_s)^{z_{s,m}} ; a_iucn in {0.225 NT, 0.395 VU, 0.645 EN, 0.980 CR} when criterion A is listed
variables: global category midpoint (MAR2.0 bridge), repeated per country; year 2015
note: 03 §1.7, §2c; never combined with the area lens

template: L_{s,c,m} = 1 - (1 - a_lpi_{s,c})^{z_{s,m}} ; a_lpi = 1 - R_ratchet(2020) ; R_ratchet(t) = prod_{u<=t} min(1, I(u)/I(u-1))
variables: in-country LPI species index I (gam_patched), down-only ratchet; year 2020
note: 03 §1.7; ratchet biased toward loss for noisy series (N08)

variables: PM = proportion of historical populations maintained (Mastretta-Yanes 2024 pilot, 9 countries; USA in this run); year 2015
R from lens area or demography; GD only; deterministic, no CI; mid-term = Ne/2 generations (WFmoments range contraction, Mualim 2026)

template: log z_{s,m,dom} ~ Normal(mean_log, sd_log) ; own: mean_log = w*log z_hat + (1-w)*mu_g, sd_log = sqrt(w)*se_log, w = tau^2/(tau^2+se_log^2) ; prior_group: (mu_g, sd_log_ppd_g) ; prior_global: (mu_0, sd_log_ppd_0) ; seed = digest2int(paste(run_id, species_id, metric, marker_domain)); set.seed(seed); rnorm(1000)
variables: 1,000 draws per species x metric x domain, reused for every country, biome, baseline and year
note: 03 §4.5; r2 draws the whole universe with seed_run_id = 20261022-r1, so r1 species reproduce r1 draws byte-identically (N10 r2 check)

template: lme4::lmer(log_z ~ 1 + (1|group), REML = TRUE) per (metric, domain); group = class (microsat) / kingdom (wgs)
variables: mu_log, tau_log, sigma_group_log, sd_log_ppd; wgs/AC z_median 0.295, wgs/GD 0.018, microsat/AC 0.119, microsat/GD 0.009
note: 03 §4.4; group variance ~ 0: priors are one distribution per (metric, domain)

template: z_hat = slope of log(diversity fraction) ~ log(area fraction) (OLS over all replicates; Schmidt published fits as given)
variables: eligible_own: z_hat > 0.001 and se/z_hat <= 0.5, not RepAdapt, one dataset per species x metric x domain

template: q_p(L) = 1 - R^{q_p(z)} if R < 1 ; 1 - R^{q_{1-p}(z)} if R > 1 ; 0 if R = 1 ;; q_p(S) = P^{q_{1-p}(z)} ; point = value at q_0.5(z)
variables: species-row quantiles q025..q975 by the exact monotone transform of the type-7 quantiles of the species' 1,000 z draws; band_kind z_only

template: mean = (1/1000) sum_d f(R, z_d)
variables: f = 1 - R^z (loss) or P^z (secured); at snapshot years {t0, 1900, 1950, 1970, 2000, 2010, 2015} (every year of this run)

template: a species contributes no row for c x e when A(t0) < 50 km2 or n_cells_eff < 0.5 (area lens); protection rows require A_t >= 50 km2 and n_cells_eff >= 0.5
variables: A_min 50 km2; n_cells_eff = sum_k v * s

template: loss_point_{c,e,g} = (1/n) sum_{s in S_{c,e,g}} point_s
variables: equal weight per member (species, or species x country pair for WLD); default weighting

template: loss_point = sum_s rho_{s,c,e} point_s / sum_s rho_{s,c,e}
variables: members with rho > 0 only; sensitivity (endemics count more)

template: loss_point = (1/G) sum_g [ (1/n_g) sum_{s in g} point_s ]
variables: mean of taxon-group means (mean-of-group-means convention, 04 §3); members without an IUCN taxon group form the group 'unknown'

template: for d = 1..1000: z'_{s,d} = z_{s,d} for own-z members; for prior members log z'_{s,d} = mu_s + (log z_{s,d} - mu_s) * sqrt(sd_s^2 - se0^2) / sd_s + se0 * delta_{m,dom,d}, (mu_s, sd_s) = the member's z_priors row (mu_log, sd_log_ppd; group row for prior_group, global row otherwise), se0 = se_mu_log of the global row for (metric, domain), delta_{m,dom,d} ~ N(0,1) one value per iteration shared by every member and every stratum (numpy default_rng(seed mod 2^32).standard_normal(1000), seed = digest2int(paste(run_id, 'shared_prior', metric, marker_domain))); then resample the n members with replacement (numpy default_rng(seed mod 2^32), seed = digest2int(paste(run_id, iso3, biome_num, taxon_group, lens, metric)) recorded in bootstrap_seed; idx = rng.integers(0, n, size = (n, 1000)) for member sets with n <= 50,000; for n > 50,000 (the pooled WLD strata) the resample of draw d is the d-th call rng.integers(0, n, size = n) of the same generator, d = 1..1000 in order, computed streamed without an n x 1000 matrix), Lbar(d) = weighted mean over the resample of f(R_s, z'_{s,d}) ; loss_mean = mean_d Lbar(d) ; q025..q975 = quantiles of Lbar(d)
variables: joint band of z uncertainty (between-species spread and the shared uncertainty of the prior's location) + species sampling; band_kind joint_mc_shared at snapshot years, z_only_shared (no resampling) elsewhere; each member's marginal z distribution is unchanged ((sd_s^2 - se0^2) + se0^2 = sd_s^2), so species rows and loss_point are unchanged; the same seed/index matrix for the three weightings of a stratum; members ordered by the species_country_loss primary key (iso3 partition, species_id, biome_num, lens, metric, habitat_def, marker_domain, baseline_year, year, pa_class, pa_year; lexicographic, NA first)
note: 03 §5.2 amendment 2026-10-23 (05 §9, methods_version 0.1.2): the original rule drew the prior-location uncertainty se0 independently per species, so over thousands of species it averaged away; the band covers z uncertainty and species sampling, not LUH2 / WDPA / range error; n > 50,000 index rule: RUN.md r3 (2026-10-24) -- statistically equivalent to the matrix rule, not identical

template: species_q10/q50/q90 = quantiles of member point values
variables: typical-species view next to the mean

template: displayed = q50 of the 1,000 joint Monte-Carlo draws (species bootstrap × z draws) with band [q05, q95]; loss_point (species mean at median z) and loss_mean (mean over draws) shown in the provenance drawer
variables: q50 is deterministic given bootstrap_seed (mc_joint) and recomputable by a verifier; loss_point is re-addable by hand from species rows but falls outside [q05, q95] in 2,423 of 89,156 r1 strata when z is strongly right-skewed (GD); loss_mean and [q025, q975] stored
note: Q8 (03 §5.2, 05 §9 amendment 2026-10-22): q50 displayed; brief decision 8 superseded

template: N_known_{c,g} = species of group g in this run whose range rows reach country c (presence cells intersect c) ; coverage_frac = n_tier1 / N_known
variables: proxy until the IUCN country list exists (n_known_source = range_rasters_this_run); demography strata use N_known_any_route = range U LPI U PM species of the run in c; WLD sums the five countries (pair basis)

template: high if n_tier1 >= 100 and coverage_frac >= 0.20 ; medium if n_tier1 >= 20 ; low otherwise ; strata with n_species < 5 are low and below_floor = TRUE ; demography_* strata: n_species and n_species / N_known in place of n_tier1 and coverage_frac
variables: n_tier1 = members with a range raster in the country; n_species = any-route members (tier 1 + tier 2); N_known = any-route count on demography rows

template: WLD rows = all biome-0 member rows of the 210 estimated countries pooled (species x country pairs, equal weight); country_name = 'all estimated countries pooled (210 countries)'
variables: re-addable from species_country_loss exactly like a country row; the estimated countries = the iso3 partitions of species_country_loss (countries with LUH2 land and at least one member row; XXX never); WLD member sets with n > 50,000 use the per-draw index rule of mc_joint, smaller ones the matrix rule (464 of 1260 WLD rows in this run, largest n = 181,558)
note: brief decision 7; 05 §9; RUN.md r3 pooled unit

template: R_ratchet(t) = prod_{u<=t} min(1, I(u)/I(u-1)) ; a_lpi(t) = 1 - R_ratchet(t)
variables: I in-country species index (gam_patched default, chain as sensitivity)

template: a_iucn, a_lpi, a_pm kept as three columns; never collapsed to one a
variables: N12 join; N13 writes one lens per source

template: (a) and (c) are two proxies for the same latent quantity (effective-size decline of the in-country population). They must never be summed, averaged, or chained (e.g. R^area * R^dem). Rules: 1. Each lens is aggregated over its own species set and stored as separate rows (lens in {area, protection, demography_iucn, demography_lpi, demography_pm}); country_summary has no combined column. 2. The product's default view is lens (a) tier 1. Lens (c) is shown as a second panel 'what demographic data say', with n for each. 3. For species in both sets, species_country_loss lets the verifier compute Delta_s = L^dem - L^area. The country-level distribution of Delta is reported as a diagnostic ('habitat vs demography agreement'); it is informative because it tests N proportional to A. 4. Species with no range map (tier 2) are not rescued by lens (c); the two remain separate.
variables: 03 §2d (its sentence 2 reads 'default view' here, per the frozen naming rule; otherwise verbatim)
